This first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant who is in custody in connection with Crime No. 507/2022 registered at Police Station Dharsiwa, District Raipur, CG for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 34 IPC 2.

Case of the prosecution in short is that complainant filed a complaint alleging that the applicant who is proprietor of M/s Swastik Steel Firm, through broker Bhavesh Patel, purchased iron ore from the firm of the complainant but not paid the amount.
3. Counsel for the applicant submit that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
He submits that the main allegations are against accused Bhavesh as he alone is responsible for non-payment of the amount .
He submits that the applicant is in jail since 11.11.2022 and the trial may take some more time for conclusion, therefore, the applicant may be released on bail.

4. State counsel opposes the application for bail and submits that looking to the seriousness of the allegations made, the applicant is not entitled for bail.
5.

Considering the rival submissions made on behalf of the parties, the facts and circumstances of the case, the nature of allegations made, that the applicant is in jail since 11.11.2022, and that the trial may take some time for conclusion, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.

Accordingly, the application is allowed and the applicant is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing a bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/- with one surety for the like sum to the satisfaction of the concerned Court for his appearance before that Court as and when so directed.

6. The applicant shall not influence any of the witnesses acquainted with the facts of the case in any manner whatsoever, and if anything like this comes to the notice of the Court below, it may cancel the bail granted to him.
